about: Framework vs game boundary (#739, tracker #747; charter -> 'Framework vs game'). Read by tests/architecture/framework-game-boundary.test.js here and by Primordial's tests/framework-boundary.test.mjs. apiSurface is every framework module game code imports, in Primordial or in the game roots still here: exactly what the split publishes (#742); each package's exports map equals its entries. A Primordial import of an unlisted module fails Primordial's test: widen the API here first. pathSeams are framework source that names a game path (process or URL boundaries, not imports); each carries the issue that removes it. skinConsumers are the framework files allowed to import the skin module contracts/game-elements.js (#740); everything else imports the vocabulary from contracts/game-vocabulary.js. A path inside both a framework and a game root is game. pathSeams and skinConsumers are exact: unused entries fail.
